name: the queue's state is reported as four counts
description: GET /api/webhook/stats is the only window into a service whose real work is a background loop, so its four fields are what a Phorge setup check and an operator both read. Every count is a live COUNT(*) over Phorge's own tables rather than a counter this service keeps, which is why the numbers survive a restart and include the work of every other instance. activeWebhooks excludes disabled hooks — that is the whole difference between it and what GET /api/webhook/hooks answers, and the seeded state has one hook of each kind so a transposition of the two cannot pass.
